issues.text: Statuses: REQ-114 done; REQ-115 done; REQ-120 stays in_progress until ORCH reads the app.yml run of the first pushed main commit holding 0002 (migration-rehearsal green, gh run view), then done (decisions/0137 Addition 7). Open LOW points to record as defects (numbers from ORCH): (1) 05b F1: no test probes the lock or admin-delay Retry-After at a fractional second (mutant ceil→floor survives); the code is right (step 9 probe: 899 at 898.5 s left); (2) the TOTP turn-off form shows its code prompt under the error label (the pattern M-4 fixed on login.html); (3) acceptance M-1: Chrome «Failed to load resource» lines for expected refusals (GET /api/auth/me 401 on every signed-out page); (4) M-2: reset.html with a live session makes one refused POST (403 csrf_refused) and one repeat; (5) M-3: the setup token field is a text field; (6) M-5: __Host-sai_s with Secure only on https, read after the deploy; (7) M-6: on Windows a stop by pid ends the server at once; (8) the comment at app/server/routes/auth.js:545 says «An unused reset link of the admin» while deleteUnusedResets(req.q, row.id) removes the unused links of whichever user changes his password; (9) audit rows for unknown e-mails: one row per failed login, bounded only by the per-address limit (step 9 probe: 30 failures from 30 addresses → 30 rows); (10) if ORCH keeps accepted lows as defects: REVIEWER P4-1, P2-1, P2-2 and SEC F4 (the pool of 3 held during scrypt). New: (11) the three ASVS residuals of 03d (2.1.1 ten characters, 3.3.2 L1 lifetimes, 3.5.3) as a question for the owner about the REQ-114 values, not a defect.

(a) `select id::text as id … order by id` orders by the text alias (1, 10, 11 …) and breaks a chain check; order by the table column. (b) A criterion part that needs a commit made only by the release push (REQ-120 c5) belongs to the post-push read of RELEASE-FINALIZER/ORCH, written so in the criterion. (c) An Addition that changes a guarded list must add its guard row in the design table at once (AP-068 class; RV-F2). (d) A security record that a criterion asks «row by row» carries the row ids of the list it answers (RV-F1).

Before the deploy that first carries 0002: (1) the owner makes the Neon restore point by docs/runbooks/backup-restore.md (RELEASE-FINALIZER asks and records his answer); (2) the owner sets SECRET_PEPPER (at least 32 bytes) and SETUP_TOKEN_HASH (from `node scripts/setup-token.js`, the token kept only by him) in Vercel; an env change applies to new deployments only. After the push: ORCH reads the app.yml run of main (REQ-120 c5). After the deploy: (3) the owner opens /setup.html once; (4) he removes SETUP_TOKEN_HASH and redeploys; (5) RELEASE-VALIDATOR on production: __Host-sai_s flags, a second /setup → 404, the headers of the four new pages, GET /api/admin/audit/verify after /setup, spike S3 (runtime role attributes, the selfcheck line of /api/health), and the timing probe (unknown e-mail against wrong password, real scrypt); UAT through app/scripts/uat-login.js with the owner's second identity waits for REQ-116.
